name: virtual-try-on-platform
description: Zero-cost AI virtual try-on platform for stores

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB,ADMIN -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: cd apps/web && npm run build && cd ../admin && npm run build
scripts.install:all: cd apps/web && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../../services/api && pip install -r requirements.txt
